postal_system.assignment_rule: 4-72 and the October 2022 UPU Colombia sheet define six digits: two for department, two for postal zone and two for district. The official viewer says the code represents an area on the national map. Valid syntax, a department prefix, UPU example, CSV-like row, locality, address, coordinate or administrative identity is not proof of a current assignment, expanded postcode, exact address, building, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The official 4-72 viewer links a national Shapefile and CSV beside an open-data clause, and its EPSG:4326 CCPP MapServer exposes separate normal-code and expanded-code polygon layers. An exact digest-pinned normal six-digit Shapefile feature may be official release geometry only after artifact-level licence applicability, mandatory attribution, update metadata, schema, layer identity, CRS, topology, validity and supersession are verified and the ArcGIS item all-rights-reserved notice is reconciled. DANE, IGAC, SINIC, parcel, community, interpolation, buffer, Voronoi, API-cache and model surfaces cannot fill missing official coverage.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, primary thoroughfare, primary quadrant, generating thoroughfare, placa or house number, secondary quadrant, neighborhood or locality, rural locality or populated centre, building or premises, floor, apartment or unit, P.O. Box, municipality or district, department and six-digit postcode separately. UPU formatting examples and synthetic fixtures are never production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as six_digit_postal_area, expanded_postal_area, postal_zone, delivery_district, po_box, organization, route, special or unknown. CodigoPostal and CodigoPostalAmpliado are distinct layers; an expanded value, property point or site-of-interest must never be collapsed into the normal six-digit polygon object.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address or nomenclature identifier, an explicit reviewed relation to an IGAC, SINIC or other permitted construction identifier, and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with cadastral manager, release, validity, legal exceptions, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. A postcode polygon, viewer property point, address text, parcel, DANE block, coordinate, containment or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: DANE DIVIPOLA and MGN supply versioned statistical and administrative department, municipality and populated-centre context. Their identities and polygons remain distinct from 4-72 assignment and geometry. Pin edition, layer, code, source-defined boundary type, territorial scope, CRS, terms and digest before crosswalking.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: IGAC and SINIC can supply rights-cleared cadastral land, nomenclature, construction and construction-unit context subject to cadastral-manager coverage, legal exclusions, layer-specific terms and stable identifiers. Parcel, construction, unit, owner, occupant and value fields remain independently governed and cannot be inferred from a postcode or published without field-level authority and privacy review.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Permitted 4-72 observations and release artifacts plus rights-cleared DANE, IGAC and SINIC data may normalize input, validate strict joins, compress reviewed geometry, build spatial indexes, detect drift and generate mathematical or machine-learning review surfaces. Every output preserves source and service version, artifact and input digests, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and official-release, official-derived or derived status. It never overwrites source evidence, fills unknown coverage or infers a placa, unit, building, organization, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate release-pinned 4-72 polygons, typed postal objects, permitted civic addresses, explicit address-to-construction relations and administrative or cadastral context to AGID cells without relabelling any source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official Colombian postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The 4-72/MINTIC open-data clause permits use, reuse, redistribution and transformation with the exact required source citation, preservation of update metadata, non-distortion and personal-data safeguards. Production must pin the clause snapshot and prove that it applies to the exact CSV or Shapefile because ArcGIS item metadata also states all rights reserved. IGAC release-level CC BY-SA 4.0 obligations and SINIC layer terms remain separate; UPU publications are not bulk-data licences and ODbL content stays partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The country pack is ISO CO scope and stores mainland, island, maritime, border, department, district, municipality, populated-centre, cadastral-manager and source-specific coverage independently. Postal, administrative, statistical, cadastral, address, construction and AGID coverage, asserted_by, legal status and vintage must not be conflated or extended beyond an artifact's declared scope.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Exact addresses, placas, apartments, coordinates, property points, parcels, construction units, organizations, recipients, owners, occupants, API responses, credentials and query logs can expose household, property, security or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review, and exclude legally reserved or personal fields from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postal assignments, normal and expanded geometries, viewer observations, the 2022 UPU sheet, S42 v8, DANE MGN editions, IGAC monthly releases, SINIC bimonthly reports, licence texts, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, service and artifact version, update date, cadastral manager, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet partitions with exact 4-72 attribution, applicable licence snapshot, source release, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Restricted addresses, property points, legal-reserve fields, credentials and query logs stay private, gated or external. Dataset Viewer is discovery and preview, a Space is a demonstration surface, and production AGID services pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
